svg.title: Push Protection Stops It; Secret Scanning Finds It
svg.desc: A push containing a secret is stopped by push protection before it reaches the repository, a secret already in history is found by secret scanning, and the remediation order is rotate first, check logs, then optionally rewrite history.
svg.text: Push Protection Stops It; Secret Scanning Finds It
Block at push, alert on history, and when something leaks: rotate first.
